author: writetextai

sections.description:
Generate, optimize, and publish SEO-rich product content automatically — titles, descriptions, meta tags, Open Graph data, and image alt text — all in one powerful plugin.

WriteText.ai combines AI content generation, SEO automation, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) to make your WooCommerce products rank higher and appear in AI-powered search results, chatbots, and voice assistants.

With bulk generation for thousands and thousands of products in one go, intelligent keyword optimization pipeline, full automation, and reusable content templates, WriteText.ai turns manual content work into an AI-powered production line.

Key Highlights in Version 3.7

  • ✅ Clearer bulk workflows: Status updates now clearly show what is queued and what is actively running
  • ✅ Improved queue handling: Bulk actions and bulk transfers can now be cancelled while queued
  • ✅ Keyword optimization clarity: PRO badge added to search intent and clearer behavior when using automatic regeneration
  • ✅ Usability refinements: Smarter template filtering based on the last generation, improved pagination, and responsive UI fixes
  • ✅ Stability and maintenance: General bug fixes, clearer help text, API enhancements, and performance optimizations

Why Choose WriteText.ai?

WriteText.ai is built for real ecommerce operations, not just copy generation.
It’s the first WooCommerce plugin that automates the entire content lifecycle — from keyword research to generation to transfer — across thousands of products.

You’ll get:
* 🔍 Smarter SEO: Keyword pipelines that evolve from easy-to-rank terms to high-value targets.
* 🤖 Full automation: Detect new products, analyze keywords, generate, and publish automatically.
* 🏗️ Custom templates: Structured layouts with reusable blocks (introductions, features, FAQs, images).
* 🌍 Multilingual power: 29 languages with cultural tone and phrasing adjustments.
* ⚙️ Enterprise-level reliability: Background processing up to 5,000 products via REST with auto-resume and connectivity checks.

Main Features

🔄 Full Automation

Set and forget. Automatically detect new products, run keyword analysis, generate optimized texts, and transfer them to WooCommerce — all while you sleep.

  • Daily cron-based new product detection (email notifications included)
  • Smart connectivity checks for seamless REST-based transfers
  • Background processing for up to 5,000 products per batch

🧱 Template Builder + Custom Prompts

Create visually structured, SEO-optimized layouts that match your brand’s tone.

  • Section-based prompts (e.g., Features, FAQs, Specs, Image captions)
  • HTML and CSS-ready output
  • Custom variables ({custom1}, {custom2}) mapped to product data fields
  • Integrated image blocks with automatic alt text

🧩 Bulk AI Content Generation

Generate descriptions, meta tags, Open Graph text, and image alt text in one pass — or target specific fields.

  • Multi-selection across filters and pages
  • Bulk keyword optimization and generation modes
  • Smart retries and handling for failed transfers
  • Background processing with REST API reliability

🔑 SEO & AEO Optimization

Built for both Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):

  • Structured Q&A and FAQ sections for higher AI visibility
  • Keyword and negative keyword management
  • Intent-based optimization for voice and AI search
  • Competitor and traffic potential insights

🖼️ Image Intelligence

Enrich your content visually with AI image analysis and alt text generation.

  • Featured image and gallery image alt text support
  • Automatic alt text regeneration during bulk or full automation
  • REST API-based image retrieval for faster transfer

🌐 Multi-Language & Collaboration

  • Supports 29 languages
  • Role-based permissions for teams and agencies
  • Readability scoring and auto-regeneration
  • Multi-store management under one WriteText.ai account

Other Details

WriteText.ai relies on third-party services to fulfill different functions in the plugin. Our own proprietary API (https://writetext.ai/) is used for:

  • Connecting to the appropriate regional server to ensure performance
  • Validating the user’s pro status or subscription and monitoring credit balance
  • Calculating the credit cost for certain actions
  • Getting up-to-date keyword data
  • Conducting real-time web research
  • Generating text
  • Fetching history log

The user must have a valid account at https://platform.writetext.ai in order to connect to this service. This connection is done upon installation through a setup wizard. You can read the Terms of Service and the Privacy Notice in our website.

SignalR is a third-party JS file used in WriteText.ai to provide asynchronous notifications and retrieve the current status of ongoing processes. It improves the user experience by keeping users informed with real-time updates during bulk actions and other operations.

The user only needs their WriteText.ai account at https://platform.writetext.ai in order to connect to this service. raw.githubusercontent.com/stefanpenner/es6-promise/master/LICENSE points to the license text for SignalR and is required to be included in the plugin as part of the license conditions.

Plans & Credits

  • Free plan: One-time 35 credits to test all features.
  • Starter: Pay-as-you-go with limited automation.
  • Pro: Advanced SEO automation and bulk tools.
  • Enterprise: Full catalog automation and API-level control.

sections.faq:
What basis does WriteText.ai use to generate product texts?

WriteText.ai combines your store’s product data with AI image analysis, real-time product research, and your own inputs to create search-optimized, brand-aligned content. The AI prioritizes inputs in this order:
1. Prompts, special instructions, or other product details you provide
2. Product data, image analysis, and target keywords
3. Product research results (if enabled)

If you only click “Generate,” WriteText.ai will still produce text based on the product name, but the more inputs you provide, the more accurate and tailored the result.

What inputs are used in generation?

Core inputs include:
* Product name (required) – The minimum input needed for generation.
* Product data (optional but recommended) – Details such as color, size, material, and specs.
* Featured image (optional but recommended) – Analyzed with AI image recognition to add visual context and fill missing details.
* Other product details (optional) – Extra facts you provide for single product generation.
* Keywords (optional but recommended) – Enter manually (Starter) or generate via AI keyword analysis (Pro). Keywords are naturally integrated into the content.

Optional enrichment (credit-based):
* Product research – Searches the web for credible, up-to-date details when store data is incomplete.
* AI-powered keyword analysis (Pro) – Finds high-potential keywords and expands coverage.

How does WriteText.ai help with SEO and AEO?

For SEO, WriteText.ai uses keyword analysis, competitor insights, negative keywords, and intent detection to ensure strong rankings. For AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), it generates structured layouts with headings, bullet points, FAQs, and Q&A sections, making your product pages easier to surface in AI chatbots, voice assistants, and search engine answer boxes.

Can I customize the look and feel of the generated content?

Yes. WriteText.ai lets you build reusable templates with structured sections such as introductions, features, specs, usage tips, FAQs, and image blocks. Each section is wrapped in a CSS class, so you can apply your own styling or map sections to page builder elements. This ensures generated text aligns with your brand’s visual identity.

How accurate is the AI-generated text?

The more product data, keywords, and images you provide, the more accurate the output. Product research and AI image analysis further improve accuracy when attributes are incomplete. WriteText.ai balances creativity with factual grounding for high-quality content.

Can WriteText.ai automatically update my product texts?

Yes. With automation enabled, WriteText.ai can detect new products, generate SEO- and AEO-ready text, and transfer it directly to WooCommerce. Content can also be automatically refreshed based on ranking changes or time-based triggers, keeping your catalog optimized without manual rewriting.

Does WriteText.ai support multiple languages?

Yes. WriteText.ai supports 25+ languages, with automatic detection based on your WooCommerce store’s language. If a language is not supported, it defaults to English.

Can I use WriteText.ai on multiple stores?

Yes. You can connect and manage multiple WooCommerce shops under one WriteText.ai account, making it suitable for agencies, brands with multiple sites, or multi-store setups.

Main Features

🔄 Full Automation

Set and forget. Automatically detect new products, run keyword analysis, generate optimized texts, and transfer them to WooCommerce — all while you sleep.

  • Daily cron-based new product detection (email notifications included)
  • Smart connectivity checks for seamless REST-based transfers
  • Background processing for up to 5,000 products per batch

🧱 Template Builder + Custom Prompts

Create visually structured, SEO-optimized layouts that match your brand’s tone.

  • Section-based prompts (e.g., Features, FAQs, Specs, Image captions)
  • HTML and CSS-ready output
  • Custom variables ({custom1}, {custom2}) mapped to product data fields
  • Integrated image blocks with automatic alt text

🧩 Bulk AI Content Generation

Generate descriptions, meta tags, Open Graph text, and image alt text in one pass — or target specific fields.

  • Multi-selection across filters and pages
  • Bulk keyword optimization and generation modes
  • Smart retries and handling for failed transfers
  • Background processing with REST API reliability

🔑 SEO & AEO Optimization

Built for both Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):

  • Structured Q&A and FAQ sections for higher AI visibility
  • Keyword and negative keyword management
  • Intent-based optimization for voice and AI search
  • Competitor and traffic potential insights

🖼️ Image Intelligence

Enrich your content visually with AI image analysis and alt text generation.

  • Featured image and gallery image alt text support
  • Automatic alt text regeneration during bulk or full automation
  • REST API-based image retrieval for faster transfer

🌐 Multi-Language & Collaboration

  • Supports 29 languages
  • Role-based permissions for teams and agencies
  • Readability scoring and auto-regeneration
  • Multi-store management under one WriteText.ai account

Other Details

WriteText.ai relies on third-party services to fulfill different functions in the plugin. Our own proprietary API (https://writetext.ai/) is used for:

  • Connecting to the appropriate regional server to ensure performance
  • Validating the user’s pro status or subscription and monitoring credit balance
  • Calculating the credit cost for certain actions
  • Getting up-to-date keyword data
  • Conducting real-time web research
  • Generating text
  • Fetching history log

The user must have a valid account at https://platform.writetext.ai in order to connect to this service. This connection is done upon installation through a setup wizard. You can read the Terms of Service and the Privacy Notice in our website.

SignalR is a third-party JS file used in WriteText.ai to provide asynchronous notifications and retrieve the current status of ongoing processes. It improves the user experience by keeping users informed with real-time updates during bulk actions and other operations.

The user only needs their WriteText.ai account at https://platform.writetext.ai in order to connect to this service. raw.githubusercontent.com/stefanpenner/es6-promise/master/LICENSE points to the license text for SignalR and is required to be included in the plugin as part of the license conditions.

  • Starter: Pay-as-you-go with limited automation.
  • Pro: Advanced SEO automation and bulk tools.
  • Enterprise: Full catalog automation and API-level control.
